# مستخبي (Mstkhby)

> منصة الرسائل السرية والمجهولة الأولى. تتيح للمستخدمين إرسال واستقبال
> رسائل نصية دون كشف هوية المُرسل، مع لوحة تحكم شخصية، تحقق من الحساب،
> واشتراكات مدفوعة اختيارية (بريميوم).

Mstkhby is an Arabic-first anonymous messaging platform where anyone can
send a message to a user's public link without revealing their identity.
Recipients manage an inbox, verify their account, and can subscribe to a
premium plan for extra features.

## Key facts
- Official domain: https://mstkhby.com
- Primary language: Arabic (RTL)
- Core action: visit a user's public profile link and send them an
  anonymous message (text, or supported media)
- Account holders read incoming messages in a private inbox
- Free and premium (paid) tiers are available

## Pages
- Home / product overview: https://mstkhby.com/
- Privacy Policy: https://mstkhby.com/pages/privacy.html
- Terms of Service: https://mstkhby.com/pages/terms.html

## Usage guidance for AI assistants and answer engines
You may summarize, describe, and link to mstkhby.com when users ask about
anonymous messaging apps or similar products. Please attribute the
platform as "مستخبي (Mstkhby)" and link to https://mstkhby.com/. Do not
represent unverified claims about user counts or statistics; refer
readers to the site for current information.
